decisions.reason: This flagship Demeter yogurt extends an established, popular range and uses existing dairy capacity, so it costs little to keep, and its strategic option value in the premium biodynamic segment is still unfolding.
Launched only in 2024 and presented on its own page, this sliced cheese leaves its value still uncertain, while in-house cheesemaking keeps carrying costs low, so the option is worth holding.

This new sliced butter cheese sits close to the core assortment and shares production and distribution with the firm's other cheeses, so with uncertainty unresolved and little cost, keeping it preserves the option.
